name: Webby Network Usage
author: SRD75

sections.description:
Webby Network Usage is a simple multisite plugin for WordPress network admins. It adds a report page in the Network Admin area that lists every site in the network, the number of active plugins on that site, and the plugin names currently active there.

This is useful for administrators who want to understand plugin usage across a WordPress multisite installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Network Admin plugins screen.
  3. Open the new Network Plugin Usage page from the Network Admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work on single-site WordPress?

No. This plugin is designed for WordPress multisite/network installations.

Does it show network-wide plugins?

Yes. Network-active plugins are included in the report for each site.
